model.title: How far is the conch's destruction the turning point of the novel?

parts.text: Evidence: the conch is shattered when Piggy is killed
Analyse: the symbol of order and the voice of reason are destroyed together
Alternative: the turning point may come earlier, when the boys leave the meeting to hunt
Conclusion: the shattering confirms, rather than starts, the collapse

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The shattering of the conch is the clearest turning point, as order and reason are destroyed at once; however, the collapse arguably begins earlier, when the boys abandon the meeting to hunt, so the shattering confirms rather than starts it.

panels.title: An Islamic lens (offered, not imposed)
points: Islam teaches fitrah: a natural inclination to good, and a conscience
Golding stresses the darkness; our faith also stresses guidance, accountability and repentance
